Agentic marketing automation
 
 
 Automation that frees you to be human 
 
 
 
Hello! We’re Dotdigital and we build technology that makes marketing more human. In one single platform, we bring together your customer data, campaign tools and cross-channel activity. We’d love to show you how.
 
 
 
 
 
Get started
 
 
Why Dotdigital?
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Personalized marketing at its best 
 
 
 
The Dotdigital platform is built to grow with your team and your customers. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Marketing automation 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Build customer journeys that trigger relevant messages. From timely cart recovery emails to SMS offer reminders, and everything in between.
 
 
 
 Explore marketing 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Personalization 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Use behavioral, order, preference, and all customer data points to create deeply personalized campaigns across email, web, and mobile channels.
 
 
 
 Explore personalization 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Loyalty and retention 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reward, retain, and build genuine advocacy through every stage of the customer journey. All without increasing your workload.
 
 
 
 EXPLORE LOYALTY 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Meet the Dotdigital AI agents 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Segment Agent 
 
 
 
Describe the audience you need, in your own words. The agent builds the segment without the need for filter logic, data teams, or spreadsheet wrestling.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Content Agent 
 
 
 
Tell the agent what you want to say, who it’s for, and where it’s going, then sit back while it writes on-brand messaging ready for any channel.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 MCP server 
 
 
 
Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets your AI tool talk to your Dotdigital data. Ask it to check results or add new leads to a list, without leaving the chat.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Human creativity driven by real data 
 
 
 
Dotdigital uses insights from its own platform and works with the world’s best research houses to bring you key stats and data every quarter, keeping your strategy and success on track
